name: _anthropic
note:
Template for a Claude profile. Create a profile from it on the Configuration page and set
the model; the profile name identifies its runs.

Model IDs (exact strings, no date suffix), list cached by the Anthropic API reference on
2026-10-06: claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5, claude-fable-5-1,
claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5, claude-opus-4-8.

Credentials: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the environment, or an `ant auth login` profile.

The SDK in use (anthropic >= 2.0) sends API version 2026-10-21, which rejects
temperature, top_p and top_k on every model. Do not set temperature: Claude samples at
the default temperature 1.0, which is recorded as the fixed value.

api_key_env = "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"

Thinking depth. Claude Opus 5.5 defaults to "medium" and Claude Sonnet 5.5 to "high";
set it explicitly so the configuration is recorded. Levels: low, medium, high, xhigh, max.

USD per million tokens, for the cost column of the log. Values from the cached price
table (2026-10-06): Opus 5.5 4.00 / 20.00; Sonnet 5.5 2.00 / 10.00; Haiku 5.5 0.10 / 0.50.
Confirm on the provider's price page and record the date.
input_per_mtok = 4.00
output_per_mtok = 20.00
source = "https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing"
accessed = "YYYY-MM-DD"

name: _ollama
note:
Template for a local model in Ollama, through its native API. Create a profile from it on the
Configuration page and set the model: a tag listed by `ollama list` (download it first with
`ollama pull <model>`). Nothing is billed and no key is needed. Ollama cloud models are refused.

Context window: options.num_ctx in the request options is required. The server default depends
on the GPU (4096 tokens with less than 24 GB of VRAM) and would cut the larger prompts; the adapter
sends num_ctx with every request and makes the server refuse a prompt that does not fit. The
prompt plus the output limit must fit: DayTrader, the largest application, has about 10,100
prompt tokens with Qwen 3.5, so num_ctx 49152 with the output limit of the hosted templates (32000)
fits every application. A larger context takes more memory: qwen3.5:4b fits in 6 GB of GPU memory
at 4k, but only two thirds of it at 49k.

Seed: leave it empty. Each attempt gets its own seed, derived from the master seed of the
experiment and recorded with it, so the runs differ. Whether the same seed gives the same answer
again depends on the model (docs/decisions.md): it did for qwen3.5:4b, not for gpt-oss:20b.

Temperature: empty uses the model's own default (Modelfile parameters, recorded with each variant).

Thinking, for models that have it (`ollama show <model>` lists the levels): "think": true or
false, or "low" / "medium" / "high" for gpt-oss, e.g.
{"think": "high", "options": {"num_ctx": 49152}}

Other model options (top_p, top_k, ...) go under "options". The study does not use "format"
(structured output): the treatment is the same prompt sent to the hosted models.

Machine of the study: RTX 4050 Laptop GPU (6 GB), Ryzen 7 7735HS, 31 GB of RAM. With a 32k
context, gpt-oss:20b keeps a quarter of itself in GPU memory and runs the rest on the CPU.

pricing.source: Local model in Ollama: no call is billed

name: _openai
note:
Template for an OpenAI profile (Chat Completions API). Create a profile from it on the
Configuration page and set the model. Credentials: OPENAI_API_KEY.

Prefer a dated model snapshot over an alias, so the version stays fixed; the API
reports the version it used, and every attempt records it.

Non-reasoning models: set the temperature (the roteiro asks for a fixed value above 0).
Reasoning models may reject it; leave it unset and record the default.
temperature = 1.0

Reasoning models only:
reasoning_effort = "medium"

USD per million tokens, from the provider's price page, with the access date.
input_per_mtok =
output_per_mtok =
source = ""
accessed = "YYYY-MM-DD"

name: _openai_compatible
note:
Template for a server that implements the Chat Completions API: vLLM, LM Studio or a hosted
gateway (OpenRouter, DeepSeek). Create a profile from it on the Configuration page.

For Ollama, use the provider ollama (template _ollama) instead. Through this endpoint the
context window cannot be set per request, so the server default applies (4096 tokens with less
than 24 GB of VRAM) and longer prompts are cut without warning; nor are the model digest and
the server version recorded.

api_key_env = "OPENROUTER_API_KEY"   # hosted gateways need a key; local servers do not

input_per_mtok = 0
output_per_mtok = 0
